[[File:Terenta.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Terenta, precursor of the Terentateks]]
'''Terenta''' were bipedal animals that were created in the [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] system by the ancient [[Je'daii Order]]. Their creation dated to the time of the [[Despot War]] where the [[Je'daii]] crafted a creature to sense [[Shikaakwa]]n explosives. [[Je'daii Master]] [[Quan-Jang]] was noted as being the one responsible for their creation. However, the Terenta eventually developed a taste for [[The Force/Legends|Force]] enriched meat and thus began targeting [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force users]]. At some point, they were deposited on Tython's moon of [[Bogan]] where they prowled the surface.

Following the exile of [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]], the fallen Je'daii [[Daegen Lok]] recruited the [[Force Hound]] in order to attain his [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]]. As a result, the pair escaped the moon and a [[Sentinel droid (Je'daii)|sentinel droid]] investigating Xesh was terminated by a Terenta. Afterwards, the Je'daii dispatched several of their number to investigate and were ambushed by a several Terenta, though the latters were slain in the insuing fighting.
